purpose: Correct pilot-scale collection before further annotation and model experiments.
qualified_count_means: Real acquired images with reviewed identity, target region, duplicates and provenance; reference-only images, transforms and duplicated frames excluded from new acquisition count.
source_unit: Documented original author/capture session or original video; URL, webpage, domain and image count are not independent-source counts.
next_steps: Inventory actual eligible source links and likely independent captures per rare class before large downloads.
Continue existing Commons categories beyond the pilot cap only after inventory; record exhaustion, duplicate and failure counts.
Estimate achievable qualified counts and source diversity; do not silently promise that every class can reach the target.
If scarce classes prevent a credible seven-class external evaluation, document a proposed benchmark/class-scope change before implementation.
